concerns.text: FR-006 (FDR correction) and FR-007 (Cluster-aware permutation) require the system to generate adjusted p-values (SC-005). While T051 and T026 implement the algorithms, task T052 ('Integrate Cluster Permutation & FDR') is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Without T052, the pipeline cannot produce the required adjusted p-values, leaving FR-006/FR-007 and SC-005 unimplemented.

SC-003 requires measuring the R² of a model trained *only* on the top 3 descriptors against a null baseline. Task T033 ('Retrain on Top 3 Features') is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). No other task covers this specific retraining and evaluation step, leaving SC-003 unimplementable.

FR-009 requires generating and persisting `data/benchmarks/runtime_log.json`. Tasks T054 (Implement Runtime Logger) and T055 (Persist Runtime Log) are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). The plan lacks a completed task to fulfill this functional requirement.

The Edge Cases section in spec.md requires the system to flag adsorbates with identical descriptors but conflicting targets. Task T016 ('Implement outlier detection...') is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Without this task, the system cannot handle this specific edge case as required by the spec.

SC-004 requires measuring the computational runtime of the full pipeline against a fixed duration. While T054/T055 address the logging mechanism, the specific task to *measure* and *report* the full pipeline duration (often part of the orchestrator or a dedicated benchmark task) is incomplete or missing as a distinct, completed step to satisfy the 'measured against' clause of SC-004.
